hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.missing: NDDOT publishes no crash cost per KABCO level: none in the Traffic Operations Manual (Jan 2026), the Crash Summary 2024, the Vision Zero Plan (SHSP 2024-2028) or the 2023 HSIP report (checked 2026-11-08)

statewide_rates.missing: no statewide average crash rate by facility type found (2026-11-08); the Crash Summary 2024 (p. 6) gives one all-roads crash rate per MVMT per county, and the Traffic Operations Manual (p. 19) points to NDDOT's high-crash lists and its segment crash map (weighted crashes per mile), which aren't published as tables

screening.state_method: NDDOT's rural and urban intersection high-crash lists and its state-highway segment crash map of weighted crashes per mile (Traffic Operations Manual, Jan 2026, p. 19)

min_years.page: p. 19, Crash Analysis ('Use 5 years for rural locations and a minimum of 3 years for urban locations')

spf_calibration.missing: NDDOT publishes no SPF calibration factors (the Traffic Operations Manual, p. 19, makes the HSM expected-crash estimate optional); no SPF engine
